as_told.title: Kandahar giant body loaded at Bagram

plain: Tim Alberino, a filmmaker and researcher, says an unnamed cargo pilot told him that during the war in Afghanistan in the 2000s he saw the body of a giant on a cargo pallet. According to the pilot, the first thing that hit him was a smell of body odor and death, and the being had red hair, pale skin, and six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. In another version Alberino credits the author Steve Quayle and a source called True Legends and puts the loading at Bagram Airfield in 2005; if true, it would mean the US military recovered an actual giant.
